scope: Authenticated Jeeves game-learning workspaces compose existing historical game-engine, simulation, ingestion, learning and product owners; no new service, external provider or runtime root

dependencies.simulation: Existing Jeeves legacy/3D/modern runtime families and explicitly registered existing ROM execution implementations only
dependencies.learning: Existing learning/evaluation principles: measured local transitions, held-out evaluation, immutable candidate lineage; no production mutation
dependencies.ingestion: Existing Dragon scrape/knowledge records are untrusted sources with owner/tenant/rights scope; no feature-owned external provider
dependencies.persistence: Existing CORE_DB Mongo application authority stores project/source/session/job revisions and policy snapshots
dependencies.product: Existing authenticated endpoint resolver and backend API; no browser-owned game or policy authority
dependencies.experimental_rom: machine/ai_game_rom_runtime.json; explicitly bounded Game Boy profile only, no universal emulation claim
dependencies.dragon: Existing current-main skeleton/ai/webcrawler native target/source builders, owner-scoped knowledge custody and practice records; no feature-owned scraping/provider

interfaces.catalogue: Truthful registered platform/engine profiles, exact action/observation capabilities and supported ingestion formats; reference simulation and full hardware emulation are distinct statuses
interfaces.sources: Bounded validated ROM/project/trace/text/Dragon evidence with digest, explicit provenance and retained rights; unknown unsupported formats remain unavailable
interfaces.editor: Server-owned project files and per-platform configuration edits with exact expected revision, canonical path/bounds and immutable history
interfaces.simulation: Bounded actual reset/step/action/observation/snapshot/restore through registered local runtime adapters; no fabricated frames or universal console compatibility
interfaces.training: Actual bounded local policy updates from measured transitions, deterministic seeds, durable policy/episode cursor, cancellation and truthful failure/recovery status
interfaces.evaluation: Executed paired candidate/baseline held-out episodes remain candidate evidence; no automatic production promotion
interfaces.generation: Seeded original compatible game projects from grounded metadata and learned policy lineage; source ROM assets/code are not copied into outputs
interfaces.export: Authorized exact-version project bundle with truthful target/runtime/toolchain capability and bounded file content

failure: Invalid source, unavailable emulator, unsupported hardware instruction/mapper, mismatched project revision, foreign source/policy identity, exhausted resources and cancelled/expired jobs fail explicitly; generic historical simulations never establish hardware compatibility
rollback: Keep source/project/policy revisions and restore the prior approved project or policy; disabling this additive UI/API does not change existing provider routing or erase canonical history
verification: User-directed one-hour source implementation; automated tests are not run or added. Compilation, lint, typechecks and build checks may run. Studio acceptance and hardware compatibility require future evidence.
implementation_scope: Actual existing coded owners, bounded local learning and studio workflow; no complete all-game/hardware compatibility or studio qualification claim
